name: INPS: 10 years of contributions, so only the vecchiaia contributiva at 71
workings: Born 1 January 1955; montante 60,000.00; 10 years of contributions; no revaluation or coefficient decline (options set to 0).
Vecchiaia contributiva at 71 (first payment the month after); 10 years < 20, so no vecchiaia: first payment February 2026, at 71 years 1 months
coefficient at 71 years 1 months: the one for 71, 6.51%
